_comment: plans/148 1단계 PoC 시나리오 공용 합성 도구(OpenAI 도구 JSON). 업무 무관 이름만 쓴다. 시나리오 파일의 tools 배열은 여기 이름을 가리킨다.

function.name: convert_currency
function.description: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another using today's rate.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the source currency, e.g. USD

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the target currency, e.g. EUR

function.name: get_recipe
function.description: Get a cooking recipe for a dish.

function.name: find_book
function.description: Search the library catalog for a book by title.

title.description: Book title or part of it

function.name: get_ticket
function.description: Get a support ticket by its id. Returns the owner's person id and the ticket's verification code.

function.name: get_person
function.description: Get a person's profile by person id. Returns the name and office id.

function.name: get_office
function.description: Get an office by office id. Returns the office name.

function.name: run_check
function.description: Run a connectivity check against a target and return the result line.
